dialogue.origin: こんばんは。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: 30分になったら始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.content: We will begin at half past the hour.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。相談員です。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどんなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: 初めてよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Is this your first time?

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you, I appreciate it.

dialogue.origin: はい。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, I look forward to working with you as well.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどうなさいましたか？
dialogue.content: What brings you in today?

dialogue.origin: 職場での上司について悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm struggling with my supervisor at work.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それはお辛いですね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんな悩みかもう少しお話いただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a bit more about your concerns?

dialogue.origin: パワハラというか
dialogue.content: It's more like workplace harassment...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 上司という立場をいいことにいろいろといってくるんです
dialogue.content: He takes advantage of his position as a supervisor to say all kinds of things to me.

dialogue.origin: 怖い思いをなさっているのですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like you're feeling frightened.

dialogue.origin: どんな要求がありましたか？
dialogue.content: What kinds of demands has he made?

dialogue.origin: 突然どなったり
dialogue.content: He suddenly yells at me,

dialogue.origin: 書類をなげつけたり。
dialogue.content: and he throws documents at me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか？！
dialogue.content: Really?!

dialogue.origin: あとは異動させるぞ、とか平気で言います
dialogue.content: He also says things like, "I'll have you transferred," without a second thought.

dialogue.origin: それは何も言い返せなくなってしまいますね・・・
dialogue.content: That must make it impossible to say anything back...

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 口答えをすると、それはそれでどなりつけるので
dialogue.content: If I try to talk back, he just yells at me for that,

dialogue.origin: どうしていいのかわかりません
dialogue.content: so I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: ええ・・お辛いですね・・・
dialogue.content: Yes... That must be really tough...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その上司はあなた以外にもそのような態度なのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Does this supervisor treat others the same way, or is it just you?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: He does.

dialogue.origin: 当たりは自分にだけ特に強いです
dialogue.content: But he's especially harsh with me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・それは困りましたね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... that's a difficult situation...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その上司がそういう態度になったのはいつ頃からとか、思い当たることはありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any idea when this attitude started or what might have triggered it?

dialogue.origin: ずっとです。
dialogue.content: It's always been like this.

dialogue.origin: 自分が入社したときはもうこんな感じでした。
dialogue.content: It was already like this when I joined the company.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 入社されてどれくらいですか？
dialogue.content: How long have you been with the company?

dialogue.origin: 3年目に入りました
dialogue.content: I'm in my third year now.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。ずっと耐えていらしたのですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see. So you've been enduring this for a long time...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 上司の機嫌のいい時もあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Are there ever times when your supervisor is in a good mood?

dialogue.origin: そう言われてみると、あまり機嫌がいいところはみたことありません。
dialogue.content: Now that you mention it, I don't think I've ever seen him in a good mood.

dialogue.origin: それは周りも辛いですね・・・
dialogue.content: That must be hard on everyone around him...

dialogue.origin: いつもビクビクしてしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.content: You must always be on edge...

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 上司以外の同僚さんたちとはどんな感じでこのことについてお話ですか？
dialogue.content: How do you discuss this with your other colleagues?

dialogue.origin: 先輩たちはあまり近づかないようにしています
dialogue.content: My senior colleagues try to keep their distance from him.

dialogue.origin: なるほどそれなりの距離をとっていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: I see—they keep a certain distance.

dialogue.origin: 用事があるときだけというか、どうしてもというときしか近づかないです
dialogue.content: They only approach him when they have business with him, or when it's absolutely necessary.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 自分もなるべくそうしているんですけど
dialogue.content: I try to do the same as much as possible, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 上司がわざわざ近寄ってきて、自分のことジロジロみていちゃもんつけるんですよね
dialogue.content: my supervisor goes out of his way to come over, stares me up and down, and finds fault with me.

dialogue.origin: それは、逃げるに逃げられないですね・・・
dialogue.content: So you can't really escape from it...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですよ。
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: みんなの前で大きい声でいろいろ言われるので
dialogue.content: He says all these things to me in a loud voice in front of everyone,

dialogue.origin: すごく嫌なんですよね
dialogue.content: and I really hate it.

dialogue.origin: はい。意見すると余計にヒートアップするということですし・・・
dialogue.content: Yes. And you mentioned that if you speak up, it just escalates...

dialogue.origin: ご自身で、どうにか工夫されたことはありましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you tried any strategies yourself to manage this?

dialogue.origin: してないですね…
dialogue.content: Not really...

dialogue.origin: 仕事が手一杯で…
dialogue.content: I'm swamped with work...

dialogue.origin: そうねすよね・・・お仕事が最優先ですもの。無理もありません・・・
dialogue.content: I understand... your work has to come first. It's perfectly understandable...

dialogue.origin: ミスしないように
dialogue.content: I try not to make mistakes,

dialogue.origin: 時間内にできるように
dialogue.content: to get things done on time,

dialogue.origin: 頑張ってやってます
dialogue.content: and I'm doing my best.

dialogue.origin: ええ、緊張して、最善を尽くしていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: Yes, you're on edge and trying your best.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 怒鳴られたりするのは嫌ですから
dialogue.content: Because I hate being yelled at.

dialogue.origin: 上司がそうやって横で目を光らせていると思うと余計にそうなりますよね
dialogue.content: It must be even more so when you feel your supervisor watching over your shoulder like that.

dialogue.origin: 近くにくると緊張して、余計に時間かかるんですよね
dialogue.content: When he comes near, I get nervous and it takes me even longer.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。気が張って余計に疲れてしまうと思います
dialogue.content: That's right. It must be exhausting to be so on edge.

dialogue.origin: 今、一番改善されたいと思う方向はどんなことがありますか？
dialogue.content: What would you most like to see improved right now?

dialogue.origin: みんなの前で怒鳴ったりしないだほしいですね
dialogue.content: I want him to stop yelling at me in front of everyone.

dialogue.origin: いろいろ言われるのも嫌です
dialogue.content: I also hate being nitpicked about everything.

dialogue.origin: ええ。上司の態度がもう少し穏やかになってほしいということですよね
dialogue.content: Yes. So you'd like your supervisor's attitude to be a bit calmer, right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 仕事自体はやりがいを感じていらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you find the work itself rewarding?

dialogue.origin: この前は
dialogue.content: The other day,

dialogue.origin: お前仕事できないんだから、遅くまで残って仕事の勉強しろ
dialogue.content: he said, 'You're useless at your job, so you should stay late and study how to do it.'

dialogue.origin: と言われました
そうなんですね・・・それはプレッシャーを感じてしまいますね
dialogue.content: I see... that must put a lot of pressure on you.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: It does.

dialogue.origin: やりがいよりプレッシャーかもしれません
dialogue.content: It might be more pressure than reward.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・でも、それに応えようと頑張るお気持ちなんですね？
dialogue.content: I see... but you still feel like you want to try and meet those expectations?

dialogue.origin: 怒られても嫌ですし、先輩たちに迷惑かけるのも嫌なので
dialogue.content: I hate being yelled at, and I don't want to burden my senior colleagues.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 自分の仕事はとにかくやらないといけないと思っています
dialogue.content: I just feel like I have to do my job, no matter what.

dialogue.origin: ええ、とても前向きなお考えで素晴らしいです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's a very positive mindset. It's admirable.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 本当なら、逃げたいと思ってもおかしくないし、嫌だというお気持ちはご自身を大事にする上でとても当然のお気持ちだと思います
dialogue.content: Under these circumstances, it would be natural to want to run away, and feeling that you don’t like it is a completely valid way of taking care of yourself.

dialogue.origin: でも、周りを冷静に見て自分のするべきことを考えていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: But you're calmly assessing the situation and thinking about what you need to do.

dialogue.origin: 人に迷惑かけたくないので。
dialogue.content: Because I don't want to cause trouble for others.

dialogue.origin: ええ。そうやって頑張っていらっしゃると周りの方もいざという時に
dialogue.content: Yes. When you keep doing your best like that, the people around you, when it counts,

dialogue.origin: 何か救いの手を差し出してくれると思います
dialogue.content: will likely reach out a helping hand.

dialogue.origin: 先輩たちはとても優しい人ばかりなんです
dialogue.content: My senior colleagues are all very kind people.

dialogue.origin: 怒られる自分をみて、いろいろフォローしてくれます
dialogue.content: When they see me getting yelled at, they support me in various ways.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。少し安心しました
dialogue.content: Is that so? I'm a little relieved to hear that.

dialogue.origin: どんな感じでフォローしてくれるのですか？
dialogue.content: How do they support you?

dialogue.origin: 仕事はもちろんですが、上司に怒られたあとは慰めてくれます
dialogue.content: They help with my work, of course, but they also console me after my supervisor yells at me.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・それは心強いですね。それで前向きなお考えを保っていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: I see... that must be very reassuring. That must be how you're able to maintain such a positive outlook.

dialogue.origin: はい。先輩たちは大好きです
dialogue.content: Yes. I really like my senior colleagues.

dialogue.origin: それはよかったです！！
dialogue.content: That's wonderful to hear!

dialogue.origin: そんな先輩たちの期待にも応えたいですね
dialogue.content: You want to live up to their expectations, too, don't you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ここで一つ提案なのですが
dialogue.content: I have a suggestion, if you'd like to hear it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その前に、質問いいですか？
dialogue.content: Before that, may I ask a question?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その上司がカッとなって怒るとき、ミスの指摘とか、いろいろあるとは思いますが
dialogue.content: When your supervisor gets angry and lashes out, I imagine it's about mistakes and other things, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 内容には納得いかない部分はどうですか？ありますか？
dialogue.content: Are there parts of what he says that you don't agree with?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: Well...

dialogue.origin: どういう感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: In what way?

dialogue.origin: なんだか思いつきで話してる？ってことがあります
dialogue.content: Sometimes it feels like he's just saying whatever comes to mind.

dialogue.origin: ええ具体的な内容よりも、仕事辞めろとか飛躍するのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So, rather than specifics, does he jump to conclusions, like telling you to quit?

dialogue.origin: 仕事のことも怒りますが、辞めろはないですけど、異動の話はよくしてます
dialogue.content: He gets angry about work-related things, but he doesn't tell me to quit. He does talk about transferring me a lot, though.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing.

dialogue.origin: そういう権限を振り回すされると怯えてしまいますね
dialogue.content: It's frightening when someone wields that kind of authority over you.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: It is.

dialogue.origin: 過去に左遷された人がいたようなので
dialogue.content: I heard someone was demoted and transferred in the past, so...

dialogue.origin: まさか、自分も？って不安にかられます
dialogue.content: I get worried, thinking, "What if that happens to me?"

dialogue.origin: ええ。確かに。無理もないです・・・
dialogue.content: Yes. I understand. That's a very natural fear...

dialogue.origin: そこで提案なのですが
dialogue.content: So, about my suggestion.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: All right.

dialogue.origin: 先ほども、同僚の中ではあなたが割と強く言われるとのことでした
dialogue.content: As you said earlier, you're the one among your colleagues who gets treated the most harshly.

dialogue.origin: 上司のようなパワハラするタイプの人は実は自分に自信がなくて
dialogue.content: People who engage in workplace harassment like your supervisor often lack self-confidence.

dialogue.origin: 相手の様子を見て、小さくなる人には余計に大きな態度になって
dialogue.content: and they gauge the other person—if someone shrinks back, they become even more domineering,

dialogue.origin: 自分を威張って見せて安心することがあります。力を見せつけないと
dialogue.content: It makes them feel secure to act high and mighty. They feel they have to show off their power.

dialogue.origin: 自分が不安なのでしょう。なので、
dialogue.content: It's likely because they themselves are insecure. So,

dialogue.origin: その、不安な気持ちをグッとこらえて上司に何か言われる前に自分からこれだけよくやってます！と
dialogue.content: if you can hold back your anxiety and, before your supervisor says anything, proactively show him what you've accomplished,

dialogue.origin: アピールしてみると相手は自分に対して認めてほしいと思っているな、と感じて態度が和らぐかもしれません。
dialogue.content: by appealing to him, he might sense that you want his approval, and his attitude may soften.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: わかりました。上司にアピールはしていませんでした。
dialogue.content: I understand. I haven't been proactive about showing my work to my supervisor.

dialogue.origin: できそうですか？
dialogue.content: Do you think you could try it?

dialogue.origin: 上司がいろいろ言う前に片付けることはあったんですけど、なかなか言えなくて
dialogue.content: There have been times when I finished things before my supervisor could say anything, but I couldn't bring myself to mention it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: アピールしてみようと思います
dialogue.content: I'll try to be more proactive in showing him my work.

dialogue.origin: これはパワハラではないんですか？
dialogue.content: But isn't this workplace harassment?

dialogue.origin: 先輩たちもパワハラだよ、という話はしていますけどどうなんですか？
dialogue.content: My senior colleagues say it is, but what's your professional opinion?

dialogue.origin: 異動をちらつかせるのはパワーハラスメントと言えると思います
dialogue.content: Threatening you with a transfer could be considered harassment.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そういうときもアピールした方がいいんですか？
dialogue.content: Should I still try to be proactive and show him my work even in those situations?

dialogue.origin: 上司がもっと穏やかになるには、というお話でしたので提案させていただきました
dialogue.content: I made that suggestion based on your desire for your supervisor to become calmer.

dialogue.origin: 上司と部下も人間関係ですよねハラスメントはそのバランスの話なので
dialogue.content: The relationship between a supervisor and a subordinate is still a human relationship. Harassment is about an imbalance in that relationship.

dialogue.origin: 上司がいわれのない不安を抱えていばり散らしているならば周りの人のフォローで変わるかもしれないという
dialogue.content: If the supervisor is acting out due to his own baseless insecurities, it's possible that support from those around him could change things.

dialogue.origin: あくまで可能性の話ではあります
dialogue.content: It's just a possibility, of course.

dialogue.origin: いかがですか？
dialogue.content: How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: 周りの人のフォローがあると上司が変わるということですか？
dialogue.content: Are you saying that with support from those around him, my supervisor might change?

dialogue.origin: 可能性もないということなんですかね？
dialogue.content: Or are you saying it's possible it won't work?

dialogue.origin: その上司の方を直接は存じ上げないのでなんとも確証は残念ながらありません
dialogue.content: Since I don't know your supervisor personally, I'm afraid I can't say for sure.

dialogue.origin: ですが可能性はなくはないのでは
dialogue.content: But I don't think it's impossible.

dialogue.origin: と、思いますが、、
dialogue.content: or at least that’s what I think...

dialogue.origin: その上司さんは職場で孤立してないですか？
dialogue.content: Is your supervisor isolated at work?

dialogue.origin: はぁ…
dialogue.content: Well...

dialogue.origin: 孤立というか、威張り散らしているので。
dialogue.content: I wouldn't say isolated, more like... he's so overbearing.

dialogue.origin: みんな相手にしません。とばっちりうけたくないので。
dialogue.content: No one really engages with him. They don't want to get caught in the crossfire.

dialogue.origin: はい近寄る人もいない・・・
dialogue.content: I see, so no one approaches him...

dialogue.origin: アピールは難しいでしょうか・・・？
dialogue.content: Would it be difficult to try that approach, then...?

dialogue.origin: さきほどのアピールはとりあえずやってみます
dialogue.content: For now, I'll give the approach you suggested a try.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。提案を受け入れていただいてありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you for being willing to try the suggestion.

dialogue.origin: アピールしてパワハラがなくなりますかね？という不安はあります
dialogue.content: I'm still anxious about whether being more proactive will actually stop the harassment.

dialogue.origin: そうですね・・・それに対しては、あるまじき行為だと、言われる側がしっかりと認識していることも
dialogue.content: That's a valid concern... In response to that, it's also important for the person on the receiving end to firmly recognize the behavior as unacceptable.

dialogue.origin: とても大事なことだと思います
dialogue.content: I believe that is very important.

dialogue.origin: パワハラはそもそもがあってはならない行為なので
dialogue.content: Because workplace harassment is something that should not happen in the first place.

dialogue.origin: どうですか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: お仕事で先輩たちもサポートしてくださるとのことなので
dialogue.content: You mentioned that your senior colleagues support you with your work,

dialogue.origin: あなたならしっかりとそんな脅しに怯えることなく活躍されると期待しています
dialogue.content: so I have high hopes that you will be able to thrive without being intimidated by such threats.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ここまでお話されてみて、いかがでしたか？
dialogue.content: Now that we've talked this far, how are you feeling?

dialogue.origin: 上司に対してアピールすることは理解しました
dialogue.content: I understand the suggestion about being more proactive with my supervisor.

dialogue.origin: パワハラに関してはちょっと不安が残りました
dialogue.content: But I'm still a bit anxious about the harassment.

dialogue.origin: どういった不安ですか？
dialogue.content: What kind of anxiety?

dialogue.origin: アピールしてパワハラはなくなりますか？
dialogue.content: Will the harassment stop if I'm more proactive?

dialogue.origin: 言われる側が認識していることが大事と言われたので
dialogue.content: You said it's important for the person on the receiving end to recognize it.

dialogue.origin: これがパワハラって認識していればいいのかな？
dialogue.content: So, is it enough for me to just recognize that this is harassment?

dialogue.origin: 認識することでパワハラは解決しますか？
dialogue.content: Will recognizing it solve the harassment?

dialogue.origin: というような不安です
dialogue.content: That's the kind of anxiety I have.

dialogue.origin: そうですね・・・認識というと弱いですね。
dialogue.content: I see... perhaps 'recognize' is too weak a word.

dialogue.origin: 認識すると然るべき行動が取れるようになると思われますが、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I believe that recognizing it will enable you to take appropriate action. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 説明がいたらず申し訳ございませんでした。
dialogue.content: I apologize if my explanation was inadequate.

dialogue.origin: すいません。いままでの行動ではダメということですよね
dialogue.content: I'm sorry. Are you saying my actions so far haven't been good enough?

dialogue.origin: ダメということはないです。その経験を次に活かすことで違う展開が生まれると思われませんか？
dialogue.content: It's not that they were no good. Don't you think that by using this experience, you can create a different outcome next time?

dialogue.origin: それで困っていたので相談したつもりでした。
dialogue.content: I thought I was consulting you because that's exactly what I've been struggling with.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: （そろそろ時間ですので終了とさせていただきます・・・力不足で申し訳ありませんでした）
dialogue.content: (It's almost time, so let's wrap up... I apologize for not being more helpful.)

dialogue.origin: （お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time. I appreciate it.)
